name: Shay Boloor

ticker_notes.OKLO: 獲能源部選中，拓展醫療材料

zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示，$OKLO 首座反應爐在不到一年內達到臨界後，獲美國能源部選中推進 Groves 2 Forge，執行長強調新反應爐可以建得多快。他們補充，Oklo 正拓展至癌症治療所用的材料，開拓電力以外的新業務。
text:
$OKLO was selected by DoE to advance Groves 2 Forge after its first reactor reached criticality in under a year with CEO saying “how quickly a new reactor could be built.”

Now Oklo is expanding into materials used for cancer treatments opening a new business beyond electricity.

name: Michael A. Gayed, CFA
zh_summary: @leadlagreport：聯準會在2024年9月截尾平均通脹為2.88%時減息50基點；現時為2.19%，會議紀錄卻傾向升息。升息無法製造石油；策略師James Thorne稱之為誤診。
text:
The Fed cut 50 bp in September 2024 with trimmed-mean inflation at 2.88%.

It is 2.19% now, and the minutes lean toward a hike.

Higher rates cannot manufacture oil. Wellington Altus strategist James Thorne calls it misdiagnosis.
